reviews.text:
Garosu-gil Rooftop Cafe Telus 9.5 is located at the top of Hotel Anteroom Seoul, about 450 meters from Exit 8 of Sinsa Station on Subway Line 3.

It is located on the main street at the end of downtown Garosu-gil.

The hotel operates a valet parking service.

It operates from 10 a.m. to midnight. Instead, the cafe menu is sold from 10 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., and the bar menu is sold from 3 p.m. to midnight.

You can see a lot of waterproof paint on Garosu-gil. It feels like this during the day, but at night there are many low-rise buildings, so the sparkling feeling is less than that of Hannam-dong or Itaewon. Still, it was good because there aren't many places where you can see a high view from this angle.

Books were on display at the entrance and indoor space. I was curious about what theme the book was introduced with, but there was no separate explanation.

The indoor temperature is a bit chilly when used in winter. There is an open glass railing terrace with a sliding door in the middle, so it is bound to be cold on days when the temperature is low. If you are someone who gets cold a lot, it is best to visit on a weekday during warm weather when the weather is clear.

reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
When I walk around my house or on the street, I feel like there are a lot of Banapresso stores, but I wasn't particularly interested because it felt like a coffee shop like Baekdabang or The Venti, but there was a big size coffee outside the store for ₩1,500. I was curious about what the coffee would taste like, so I visited without any special expectations.

There is a customs intersection branch close to my house, but that branch is a large store, so it feels more like a factory, like Starbucks, so I stop by the Eulji Hospital intersection branch, which is a little further away but is small and feels like I can inject a little more soul when making coffee.

I was a little hesitant to go into the Banapresso store because it was pink, but I just went in.

The store was as small as its exterior and felt like a franchise, so I didn't have anything special to say about it, so I ordered an iced Americano from the kiosk installed next to the store entrance.

Customers keep coming in, ordering at the kiosk, and waiting for their drinks.

While waiting for the iced Americano to come out, I took a picture of the kiosk's menu and it seemed like there were more than a hundred different types of drinks. Wow.. the last time I thought the Big Pound Coffee in front of Ewha Womans University had a lot of menu items, they were at least acceptable.

Since there are so many menus, I mainly focus on coffee items, but the Specialty Americano menu that says Customer Appreciation Event on the recommended menu caught my eye.

I'm easily tempted by events or discount promotion menus, and when I heard the word "specialty," I ran at the speed of light to a female employee who was brewing the coffee ordered by the customers. When I scanned the coffee being brewed, the iced Americano I ordered only had cold water in the cup and it seemed like they had only brewed espresso shots for the customers in front of me. I asked if I could change it to a specialty Americano. They asked for my order number and said they would.

Phew, that was a relief. When I asked what exactly specialty Americano is, I was told that they use Ethiopian coffee beans, and among them, they use specialty grade coffee beans. Huh? When it comes to Ethiopia, my favorite is Wondunde. Also, if it's a specialty grade, it's expensive, so you can taste it for 2,000 won?

Additionally, as the female employee explained about the coffee beans and looked at her posture, I felt like she was a barista rather than just a part-time employee, so I waited with my heart pounding. This is my first time getting excited at a chain coffee shop like this.

While the beans were ground on the spot and the espresso was being made, the female employee came out of the counter for a moment and went to the kiosk, canceled the iced Americano I had ordered earlier, and told me I could order the specialty Americano again. I ordered specialty Americano again from the kiosk.

After waiting a bit, the iced Americano made with Ethiopian specialty grade coffee beans that I ordered came out in a Starbucks Venti size cup.

When I come out of the store and take a sip, the acidity is good, but when I hold it in my mouth and roll my tongue, I can feel a subtle scent of flowers or berries, which I think is good.

In addition, even though it was about the size of a venti, the taste was not light or mild, so I looked at the label the barista put on the cup and it said it was 2 shots. Wow.. but 2,000 won.. awesome! Shout “Yabai!”

If you want to taste a Venti size with 2 shots of the same coffee beans at Starbucks, it would probably cost more than 8,000-9,000 won. Of course, the atmosphere is different, but since I was drinking takeout, I was amazed at how great of a deal it was.

Overall, I had a preconceived notion that the coffee from these Bakridamae coffee chains was literally just for caffeine replenishment, but when I visited today, I found out that even though the beans are not roasted freshly in a more professional store like Roasters or Roastery, it was nice to be able to enjoy coffee using high-quality specialty coffee beans ground on the spot for the price of 2,000 won, and in 2 venti-sized shots, so I think I will visit often.

reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
On the way to Saketsubasa, I stopped by Starbucks because it was a hot day.

The store was located on the 2nd floor, and when I went up the stairs and entered the store, it was quite spacious. I wanted to sit down and eat, but there were no empty seats, so I scanned for a while and saw a customer standing up, so I quickly took a seat and went to the counter and asked for an Ice Blonde Cafe Americano in a venti size. I would drink it at the store, but asked that it be in a disposable cup, not a store cup.

I, too, have tried drinking from store cups a few times in the past to protect the environment, but since I enjoy Americanos without milk rather than lattes with milk, I would have done my best to wash the dishes, but the fishy smell of milk seeping into the store cup made me feel bad, so I had no choice.

As soon as I finished paying, it was already ready, and when I went to get the Ice Blonde Cafe Americano, I was confused every time. The size was small, so it only looked like a tall size to me, so I asked again, "Is this the correct Venti size?" and when I heard the answer that it was, I tilted my head, took it, and returned to my seat.

If it's the venti size, I feel like it should be twice the size of the venti in front of me, so I ordered the venti size for no reason even though it's not that big.

The paper straw doesn't last long and gets mushy, so I just drink it because I'm afraid the paper taste will get mixed up with the coffee. I didn't expect anything special from Starbucks coffee, but the lighter-tasting blonde tasted so-so, so I would have gone to another Gagel or ordered a different menu.

Still, it was a spacious store, so I took a break, cooled down, and got up.

Overall, I don't expect anything special from Starbucks, but the venti size felt too small for me, like a tall size, so the price was expensive and the coffee tasted so-so, so I felt like I should have chosen something like Frappuccino the next time I stopped by.

reviews.author: elilolulolilela Al (Jk)
reviews.text:
A yogurt restaurant in Sinsa-dong that boasts beautiful interior and exterior. A delicious, pretty, and blameless place. They sell chewy Greek yogurt as their main menu, as well as granola, smoothies, and crispy chunks.

Since this is a brand included in Market Kurly’s initial lineup, we can guarantee its taste. In fact, it is a flavor that I buy often, and yogurt ice cream with a square texture is something I really crave, especially in this weather.

I'm not very impressed with Dodger, but I think it's a place that sells a higher quality menu than most other cafes in Sinsa-dong.

reviews.author: Yummyun
reviews.text: I go there sometimes to get ice cream. It's fresh and delicious. The store is pretty, but I wish I could sit down and eat it. It's a shame.

reviews.author: Guide World gourmet (Julia)
reviews.text:
I stopped by during my morning walk and found this to be an unexpectedly great experience.

Yogurt topped with rich fruits not only looks cute but also tastes great. The rich, creamy yogurt and the sweetness of fresh fruit are an exquisite match. And the surprising thing is the savory yogurt topped with salmon and blue cheese. It's like a light brunch, and I feel like I've discovered a new way to enjoy yogurt.

A hidden and recommended spot in Gangnam where you can enjoy a special dish in the morning.

reviews.author: 化学調味料ちゃん
reviews.text:
The store opened in 2009 as Korea's first organic Greek yogurt brand.
Yogurt is very popular recently!

Yogurt in a stylish dish like a French restaurant and a combination like an Italian appetizer.

Grapefruit brûlée
Gorgonzola cheese & peach
order.

Both go well with moist, delicious yogurt and fruit!
The grapefruit was soaked in olive oil and was very delicious!

There are 2 tables inside and 2 tables outside.
The staff works alone.

I was late to come out, but I can't help it if the staff is alone and the place is full.

reviews.author: Taste Log
reviews.text:
A good espresso bar.
It's much more delicious than the cream latte available in every popular cafe these days. I don't usually drink it, but it was so delicious here that I drank it all to the end.

Perhaps because it was a weekday, not many desserts were prepared.
The atmosphere was nice, so I was able to enjoy it comfortably.

reviews.author: manul garlic
reviews.text: Espresso bars seem to be trendy these days. While traveling in Seoul, you can see new espresso bars in various places, including Hotple. Pacino Espresso Bar here is an espresso bar that seems to have been influenced by Al Pacino. Espresso is an authentic Italian coffee made by passing hot water under high pressure through finely ground and compressed coffee beans, and has a strong taste and aroma. This place also offers sides that go well with this espresso, so it's a great way to pass the time.

reviews.author: Dewani Cage
reviews.text:
An espresso bar with a unique and exotic atmosphere. However, even though it is an espresso restaurant, it was disappointing that the coffee was not unique. The flavor is average and the concept is average.

The cheesecake was unexpectedly rich and flavorful. It's creamy and has a slightly spicy flavor of cheese, so people may have different opinions, but I recommend it. I wouldn't necessarily visit again, but the store is attractive so it's worth a visit at least once.

I intend to visit again ♥️

reviews.author: Misun Kang
reviews.text:
This is a popular American pie cafe in Sinsa! The pie is so delicious that there is even a waiting line on weekends👍 The pie is large and the cream on the cake is not too greasy or sweet and has a refreshing taste. In addition to the fruit on top, there is also fruit stuck inside the pie, so it combines with the cream👍 The pie is also delicious because it is crunchy and savory! Banana cream pie and cherry chip pie are so delicious😊 If you can’t decide what to eat, I like to eat cherries or bananas! The exciting pop music and the American-style interior are so pretty that it's great for a date. Pie take-out is also available, and you can do it right away without waiting.
If you are looking for a dessert restaurant in Sinsa, be sure to visit Taujeonde. I had a delicious meal.

reviews.author: Namanbara Capybara
reviews.text: The atmosphere of the store is really warm and makes me feel like I'm at an American home >_

reviews.author: yamB
reviews.text:
If you want to eat thick and rich pie, this is the place to go.

I can't believe there was such a nice and delicious pie shop in the shrine....

There are so many types of pies.

1. Soft and moist cheese blueberry pie
2. Thick chocolate mud pie
3. Sweet pumpkin pie
4. Soft banana cream pie
5. Tiramisu pie, full of coffee flavor
6. Refreshing cherry chip pie
7. Savory peanut butter pie
8. Pecan Pie

There are more than that, but they were sold out today o̴̶̷᷄﹏o̴̶̷̥᷅

There were many types of drinks.
Highly recommend the Brown Pistachio Latte....

The chewy pistachio flavor every time you drink the drink is so attractive.

This pie would be a welcome gift to buy as a gift to a friend or a family with babies🩷

There are a lot of tables in the cafe, so it's great for chatting with friends, and the atmosphere is great, so it's great for taking pictures!!! 👍

reviews.author: Yumin Jang
reviews.text:
I found a great pie restaurant in Garosu-gil where you can feel the local American sensibility!🇺🇸 First of all, the interior is vintage and exotic, so I started taking pictures as soon as I entered. 📸

The banana cream pie is soft itself, and the peanut butter pie is thick and rich, but surprisingly not overly sweet, so I enjoyed it until the end! 🥧 In particular, the pairing with the savory iced cafe latte was truly a work of art, so I ate it with admiration. ☕️✨

They also sell sentimental goods like mugs and cute stickers, so it's a lot of fun to look around. Friendly service is a bonus! I am 1000% willing to revisit! 🧡

reviews.author: summer
reviews.text: I like the stylish interior and atmosphere. There were so many different types of pies that I just chose because I wanted to try them all🤤 I had apple pie and banana cream pie, and the apple pie was topped with ice cream, which made it even more delicious! We also have decaffeinated coffee and oat milk latte😍

The pie was thin but crispy, and the ingredients were fresh and plentiful, so it was fun to chew! I had a pecan pie and a pigray pie. The pigray was a subtle earl gray and a pile of figs, which went well together. The pecan pie was sweet and delicious, but the tiny pecans were chewy, so I enjoyed everything on the menu! Recommended :)

reviews.author: Chanho Andrew Kim (MUYO)
reviews.text: It is said to have started in Gwangjin-gu and expanded to Garosu-gil, and is a pie restaurant that opened next to Old Perry Donuts. From the entrance with the American-style sign, you can feel the foreign-style interior, but the interior is reminiscent of an American steak restaurant, and the English posters posted here and there make you feel like you are in a foreign country. There are a variety of pies on display in the store. After lunch, I ordered the most popular pumpkin pie and coffee. The pumpkin pie was a very crispy pie with pumpkin on top and cream cheese on top, so the harmony between each ingredient was good, but the taste of the cream cheese, which was not sweet, felt a little stronger than the pumpkin. The coffee also had a very American feel. It had a slightly burnt flavor similar to the original pancake house coffee, and I thought it went well with the pie. Recently, many cafes specializing in pies have opened up, and unique pies have become very popular, so I liked them as I prefer pies with a more classic feel or crispy pies. One thing that is disappointing is that they placed a long table in the middle and high tables and chairs on both sides, but the spacing between the tables is narrow, so customers on both sides touch their bodies when moving, the high table has a high center, making it uneasy, and the chairs are also high, so I thought it would be better to change the interior structure.

reviews.author: Jean J
reviews.text:
A pub-like cafe with a vintage American feel.
The music is good because it plays old pop music to suit the mood, and the interior accessories make me feel like I was on a trip to America.
Above all, there are many types of pies and they are of high quality, which is reasonable considering that it is a tree-lined road near the water these days.
I really liked the no-sugar milk tea.
The taste and atmosphere are the best among the cafes I've been to recently.

I went to a long-awaited meeting at Garosu-gil.
After having Mexican food for lunch and walking around, a coffee shop caught my eye... It was relatively friendly and had a lot of coffee options. I ordered a latte, mocha coffee, and a strawberry tiramisu scone and enjoyed it.
Coffee taste is just average / dessert taste is ok and not too sweet~~

reviews.author: Ga young Bae
reviews.text: Let’s go here to try the signature summer latte. The interior is a bit exotic but has an old feel, and on the other hand, even though this store has been in Sinsa-dong for a long time, it feels like a lot of hip people come here. (Same as Daegu's Brown Briggs) Summer Latte is 7,500 won per cup, but it's worth it. They give you a rich latte with two frozen chunks of vanilla ice cream and what appears to be mabel syrup sprinkled on top. It's so bittersweet that I keep reaching for it. The employees were friendly, but the owner or manager, who was sitting outside and having a drink, sprayed a strange spray on the cabinet for several minutes and it smelled bad, and it felt like the spray was all blown over by the wind. I wish they would be a little more considerate and do it when there are no customers, but I plan to come back to try the summer latte. It's a taste that comes to mind sometimes. The new Matcha Summer Latte was also bitter and delicious. But the original is the best...

reviews.text: When it first opened, I went in without thinking, but fell in love with the coffee and bread, and suddenly became a regular. This restaurant's signature menu item is dumpling bread. Thick meat and kimchi handmade dumplings are baked in the oven and sold in 5 different types. If you try them, you will experience a whole new world. It's a taste that always comes to mind when I get home. The prices are similar to other stores and the staff is really friendly. It's small, so there are only about 3 tables, but it has a cozy feel.

reviews.author: The Dude
reviews.text:
This is a new bakery cafe in Sinsa-dong, an Uber competitive area.

Fortunately, it offers a unique taste that is a bit different from other bakery cafes. It's dumpling bread. If you know Shanghai's signature dish, half-friend dumplings, this bread tastes similar.

They're basically a fully baked version of Half Friend Dumplings, and come in six flavours.

The spicy version has kimchi, but I prefer the pizza flavor.

reviews.author: Yeonju Lee
reviews.text:
The best dessert restaurant of your life!!
The cannelé is really crunchy on the outside and soft and moist on the inside.
The lemon madeleine is also soft and delicious with a subtle lemon scent.
Milk cream scone cream has a luxurious creamy taste! The scones don't really taste like flour, so I'm sure all the desserts here will be delicious!
In the middle of winter, blankets and hot packs are provided, and the signature Gongmyeong Latte is full of cinnamon and so delicious.
Aside from the fact that it's hard to get a seat because there are so many people, the desserts are delicious so I'd like to visit again.
I heard there are several branches, including Hapjeong and Yeonnam, so I want to go to other branches next time👍👍

reviews.author: HyeYeon Seo
reviews.text:
Visit at 2pm on a weekday. I was the second person to wait in line and waited about 10 minutes before entering.

I ordered Australian style cappuccino hot (₩5,800), flat white (₩5,500), and homemade mascarpone tiramisu (₩8,500). You order at the counter and it is delivered in the order it was made.

They say it's a crumble restaurant, but the tiramisu is so delicious. It melts smoothly in your mouth and is moderately sweet. The coffee overall is not sweet and has a bitter, nutty aftertaste. I think it would be better to eat it with ice.

✔Parking was done in the public parking lot of nearby Shingu Elementary School.
✔There are more foreigners than Koreans. It's a bit of a chaotic atmosphere.

Arrived at 2:30 PM on Friday.
There were no seats indoors, so I put my name on the waiting list, sat down outside, and waited for about 10 minutes to get a seat.
It's not a very large space, but with 4-5 employees working busily, the coffee I ordered came out in 5 minutes, and I was satisfied with both the iced almond latte and flat white.
The space between tables is narrow and there are many people, so it has a noisy atmosphere, but the biggest advantage is that they have delicious coffee and desserts (the baristas are friendly), and it is a space with its own charm.

reviews.author: Chris Ocean
reviews.text:
Whether you are a car enthusiast or a motorcycle enthusiast, this is a must-visit place before leaving Korea.
The owner and some of his employees speak English fluently, having graduated from ACC, one of the world's top design schools.

In addition, EREVO holds a "Rolling Sunday" event every Sunday from 9 to 11 a.m., where people who own old cars gather to enjoy delicious coffee.

Highly recommended.

reviews.text: I stopped by by chance while passing by and was really lucky. The coffee was delicious, the atmosphere was cozy, and the owner was really friendly. I definitely want to come back.

reviews.author: Ali G
reviews.text: It's a cute, pretty vintage clothing and bookstore that also sells coffee. The coffee price is very reasonable (latte 3,500 won) and the owners are friendly. I couldn't find any vintage clothing that I liked, but it was nice to see that there was children's clothing and some cool trench coats displayed on the wall.

reviews.author: Celine Parbelle
reviews.text: The coffee was delicious and the service was great! I was touched by the warm hospitality, and the vintage products were really good and the prices were reasonable, so I was satisfied.

reviews.author: D.W.C Love
reviews.text: Since it is a newly opened place that sells salads and coffee, the interior is clean and comfortable. There are many types of salads to choose from, so it's fun to eat them. The taste is really fresh and the dressings are varied and delicious. The prices and portions are reasonable, the coffee is delicious, and everyone working there is friendly. You can eat inside or take out. Free parking is available in the building, and separate bathrooms for men and women are available in the building's public restroom.
